text:
alex.sales: FYI — ACME asked for a private VPC deployment and is pushing to waive the platform fee for year 1 if they sign a 12‑month commit. They sent a redlined SOW draft. Need deal desk + SE + eng input before I reply.

sarah.se: Quick Qs — what's their expected steady RPS and peak concurrency? POC or full rollout? Platform fee primarily covers the private control plane + on‑prem packaging + dedicated infra support.

alex.sales: They want a staged POC first (90 days) then full roll. Estimate in email: 150 RPS steady, spikes to ~600 during batch jobs.

miguel.eng: For those numbers VPC-only deployment is fine. Engineering effort: 3 engineer-days for VPC onboarding. On‑prem (air‑gapped) needs more — 7–12 days + one‑time packaging. Also we charge a one‑time deployment engineering fee for on‑prem.

devin.dealdesk: High level pricing levers we can pull: platform fee discount (for annual commit), one‑time deployment fee (can be moved to SOW/one‑time line), and support tier upsell. We can consider a migration credit for the POC if they convert.

devin.dealdesk: Numbers (ballpark, need finance signoff):
```
Platform fee (list): $25,000/mo
Support (Enterprise 24x7): $5,000/mo
One-time on-prem packaging: $40,000
12mo commit discount: 30% off platform fee -> $17,500/mo
POC (90d) promotional fee: 50% platform fee, cap $10k for the POC
```

sarah.se: Security note — they require SOC2 + KMS integration and host scanning report. Security will need to run the questionnaire; timeline ~4–6 weeks for full answers if we need new artifacts. For VPC private control plane we can enable customer KMS (requires KMS config + key policy review).

security-bot: /security-request created: ACME SOC2 + KMS intake (ticket #SEC-2026-183). Assigned to @tara.security. ETA initial reply 3 business days.

alex.sales: Can we convert the one‑time on‑prem fee into professional services line on the SOW so the rate card doesn't need permanent changes? Customer prefers less line items but legal prefers clarity.

devin.dealdesk: Yes — we typically put it as SOW professional services. That avoids changing published rate card. For legal exceptions (indemnity / export controls) we need GC signoff. I'll loop in legal if we route for exception.

finance-bot: Heads up — if we do the 30% platform discount and spread over 12 months, revenue recognition requires contract start date and committed monthly amounts in the contract. Finance needs final numbers before signature to model cashflow.

alex.sales: Proposal plan: 1) Offer 90d POC at 50% platform fee (cap $10k) VPC-only, 2) Post-conversion 12mo commit with 30% off platform fee, 3) Move any on‑prem packaging fees to SOW as professional services, 4) Support = Enterprise 24x7 (add on). Anyone object?

miguel.eng: Fine technically. If they go air‑gapped we'll need extra security checklist items and additional eng days + possible license gating. Call that out in SOW.

devin.dealdesk: Sounds fine. I need the ACV estimate to run the approval path. If total committed ARR > $1.2M this goes to CRO approval; otherwise I can approve with finance signoff. Please drop an internal summary doc link and estimated ARR.

alex.sales: Estimated post‑POC ARR = ~$630k/year (after discount) based on their usage. Dropping summary now. @devin.dealdesk please start the approval thread.

customer.johnson: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We're ok with a POC and then committing if the perf checks out. Tight on procurement timelines — prefer to start onboarding within 2 weeks.

devin.dealdesk: Noted. I'll kick off the approval; looping in legal and finance now. Expect an approval timeline of 48–72 hours for internal deal desk review assuming ARR numbers are accurate.

alex.sales: Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate SOW edits. Will post the SOW link and security intake link here once ready. :thumbsup:
